keyFindings: Police case filed Oct 2025 after dog died during grooming session (Sep 28). Yerawada Police investigating toxic soaps/materials. Case under BNS + Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act. 125K+ review count is across ALL Vetic branches nationally, not this location alone.
redFlags: POLICE CASE (active); DOG DEATH during grooming; 125K reviews is CHAIN-WIDE not local (inflated); investigation ongoing
recommendation: HOLD onboarding until police investigation concludes. High brand value but active criminal case is a dealbreaker for now.

keyFindings: Only 2.5 stars on Practo from actual patient reviews. Complaints: premature spaying advice (15 days after first heat leading to behavioural issues), non-transparent billing, cash-only for surgeries, ₹5000 spent on ineffective hair loss treatment. JustDial rating of 4.5 likely inflated.
redFlags: 2.5 PRACTO RATING; non-transparent billing; cash-only surgeries; ineffective treatments reported; JD vs Practo rating mismatch suspicious
recommendation: CAUTION. Experienced doctors (34 yr) but serious service complaints. Onboard only with strict SLA & customer feedback monitoring.

keyFindings: Customers report: very dirty facility, bad odor, online photos DON'T match reality, dogs shifted from cages without notification, dog developed skin infection during stay. Cleanliness is fundamental for boarding.
redFlags: POOR HYGIENE; BAD ODOR; MISLEADING PHOTOS; SKIN INFECTIONS; dogs moved without consent
recommendation: DO NOT ONBOARD. Hygiene failures in boarding = liability. Misleading photos = trust issue.

keyFindings: Legitimate multi-branch chain, 20+ yr exp. However: complaints about HIGH PRICING, prioritizing charges over stray animal care, some reports of inexperienced doctors at certain branches. Main branch Sinhagad Rd is well-reviewed.

recommendation: ONBOARD with caution. Verify Viman Nagar branch staff specifically. Good for premium segment customers.

keyFindings: 15-year business, 727 reviews is substantial. Complaints: products can be EXPENSIVE compared to competitors, quality issues (harness stitches came out in 3 days). But overall solid reputation.

recommendation: ONBOARD. Established & reliable. Flag pricing concern — may not suit budget customers.

keyFindings: 4.1 is decent but not great for 185 reviews. Large 4000 sq ft facility with pool. Run by retired army officer. Limited negative info found but 4.1 suggests some unhappy customers exist. LBB and BlogAdda features suggest real business.

keyFindings: Linked to Hadapsar area where an illegal vet center was shut down by Maharashtra State Vet Council. Unclear if Pet Palace Clinic itself was the one shut down or a different entity. Dr. Deepak Suryawanshi operates it.
